lines.text: Saul takes three thousand chosen men to look for David and goes into a cave to relieve himself.
David's men urge him to act, but he only cuts off a corner of Saul's robe and restrains them.
David bows facedown before Saul outside the cave and shows him the corner of his sword.
David calls himself a dead dog and a flea, and Saul weeps and calls David his servant.
Saul says David will be king, David gives his oath, and David and his men go up to the stronghold.
